name: Direction-Adaptive DWT (DA-DWT)
definition: A DWT where the direction vector $d$ changes dynamically based on spatial location to optimize energy compaction for localized directional features. Requires signaling direction information in the code-stream.
summary: Direction-Adaptive DWT is a wavelet transform that dynamically selects direction vectors per block to optimize energy compaction for localized directional features in volumetric data.
